'''Gimban Togglefuse''' is a [[gnome]] located in the [[Grim Reaches]]. Along with his companions [[Dorthas Read]] and [[Torlag]], he set up camp near a tunnel leading into the [[Ruins of Grim Batol]] to investigate the [[Shadow Curse|darkness]] that laid within now spreading out into the Grim Reaches.
